scenes.text: On Monday, Amara was your worst nurse. By Wednesday, she was your best. Nothing about her changed.
So who do I praise... and who do I retrain?
Neither. Meet the Red Bead Ward, a simulation in Lean Six Sigma for Healthcare.
Six nurses draw from the same box. Red beads are defects. Press next day, and watch the league table shuffle itself.
Worker of the day. Needs retraining. A different name every single day. It's pure chance.
Predict the weakest performer, then run it. Every point sits inside the control limits. The differences come from the system.
So I've been blaming people... for the box.
Deming put it simply. Most performance problems belong to the system. The Learning Studio shows you the history, the maths, and the clinical story.
Stop ranking people. Start fixing systems. Start free today, at Lean Six Sigma dot Healthcare Crown Academy dot co dot uk.
